issue.title: Expose public verification API
issue.body:
### Problem

Public API under org.mockito.verification.* leaks internal APIs:
 - VerificationMode leaks internal VerificationData interface
 - VerificationData leaks InvocationMatcher concrete class

### Options

1. Move VerificationData to public package, hide behind an interface: #728
2. Deprecate internal types, create new public interfaces, delegate to deprecated APIs to avoid breaking API compatibility and behavior.

### Recommendation

- Option 1 is easier to implement. It introduces breaking change on an internal type. This is legal from the standpoint of semantic versioning.
- Option 2 adds some implementation overhead and leaves some deprecated code. It is fairly easy to implement, too. Although it is legal to change private API at will, this particular API was leaking from public api (for many releases) so users may have started depending on it.

+1 for option 2.

### Plan

- org.mockito.internal.verification.api.VerificationData deprecated by new org.mockito.verification.VerificationData
- org.mockito.internal.verification.api.VerificationData.getWanted() deprecated by new org.mockito.verification.VerificationData.getTarget()
